13:
SELECT s."phone"
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s
  ON s."cdscode" = sat."cds"
WHERE sat."numtsttakr" IS NOT NULL
  AND sat."numtsttakr" <> '0'
  AND sat."numge1500" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (CAST(sat."numge1500" AS NUMERIC) / CAST(sat."numtsttakr" AS NUMERIC)) DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 3;
17:
SELECT
    s."school",
    sc."avgscrwrite",
    s."charternum"
FROM satscores sc
JOIN schools s
    ON s."cdscode" = sc."cds"
WHERE sc."avgscrwrite"::NUMERIC > 499
  AND s."charternum" IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s."charternum") <> ''
ORDER BY sc."avgscrwrite"::NUMERIC DESC NULLS LAST;
10:
SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = f.cdscode
WHERE s.avgscrread = (
    SELECT MAX(avgscrread::BIGINT) FROM satscores
)
LIMIT 1;
84:
WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT "admfname1" AS first_name, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname1" <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname2" AS first_name, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname2" <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname3" AS first_name, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname3" <> ''
)

SELECT
    an."first_name",
    an."district",
    COUNT(*) AS name_count
FROM admin_names an
GROUP BY an."first_name", an."district"
ORDER BY name_count DESC NULLS LAST, an."first_name" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 2;
73:

FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s."school" LIKE '%Youth Authority%'
  AND s.mailstreet LIKE '%PO Box 1040%';
14:

    s."school" AS school_name,
    s."ncesschool" AS nces_school_id,
    f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enrollment_ages_5_17
FROM "schools" s
JOIN "frpm" f
    ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"::NUMERIC DESC NULLS LAST

39:

FROM "satscores" s
JOIN "schools" sc ON sc."cdscode" = s."cds"
WHERE sc."city" LIKE '%Fresno%'

82:

FROM "schools" AS s

50:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s."sname" AS school_name,
        s."avgscrmath" AS avg_math,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s."avgscrmath" DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
    FROM "satscores" s
    WHERE s."avgscrmath" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    sc."school" AS school_name,
    sc."mailstreet" AS postal_street_address
FROM ranked r
JOIN "schools" sc
    ON sc."school" = r.school_name
WHERE r.rn = 7
57:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s."cds",
        s."avgscrwrite",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s."avgscrwrite" DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
    FROM "satscores" s
    WHERE s."avgscrwrite" IS NOT NULL
)

    sch."phone",
    sch."ext"
FROM ranked r
JOIN "schools" sch

SELECT
    s."avgscrmath" AS "avgscrmath",
    s."cname" AS "cname"
FROM "satscores" s
WHERE (s."avgscrmath" + s."avgscrread" + s."avgscrwrite") IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (s."avgscrmath" + s."avgscrread" + s."avgscrwrite") ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;
37:
SELECT
    s."street",
    s."city",
    s."zip",
    s."state"
FROM "satscores" sc
JOIN "schools" s
    ON s."cdscode" = sc."cds"
WHERE sc."numtsttakr"::numeric > 0
ORDER BY (sc."numge1500"::numeric / sc."numtsttakr"::numeric) ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;
27:
SELECT
    s."school",
    sa."avgscrwrite" AS "average_writing_score",
    s."phone" AS "communication_number"
FROM "schools" s
JOIN "satscores" sa
    ON s."cdscode" = sa."cds"
WHERE
    
    (s."opendate" IS NOT NULL AND s."opendate" <> '' AND s."opendate"::date > DATE '1991-12-31')
    OR
    
    (s."closeddate" IS NOT NULL AND s."closeddate" <> '' AND s."closeddate"::date < DATE '2000-01-01')
ORDER BY sa."avgscrwrite" DESC NULLS LAST;
34:
SELECT
    f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "free_rate"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE (s.admfname1 LIKE '%Kacey%' AND s.admlname1 LIKE '%Gibson%')
   OR (s.admfname2 LIKE '%Kacey%' AND s.admlname2 LIKE '%Gibson%')
   OR (s.admfname3 LIKE '%Kacey%' AND s.admlname3 LIKE '%Gibson%');
49:
WITH closed_counts AS (
    SELECT
        s."county",
        COUNT(*) AS closed_cnt
    FROM "schools" s
    WHERE s."statustype" = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY s."county"
    ORDER BY closed_cnt DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    s."school",
    s."closeddate"
FROM "schools" s
JOIN closed_counts cc
    ON s."county" = cc."county"
WHERE s."statustype" = 'Closed'
ORDER BY s."closeddate" ASC NULLS FIRST;

    f."District Code",
    (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" * 100) AS "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)"

    ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode

    f."Low Grade",
    s.school
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode

35:

FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"

28:
WITH avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(
               CAST(f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS NUMERIC) - CAST(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS NUMERIC)
           ) AS avg_difference
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
    WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Locally funded'
)

SELECT
    s.school,
    s.doctype
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
CROSS JOIN avg_diff a
WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Locally funded'
  AND (CAST(f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS NUMERIC) - CAST(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS NUMERIC)) > a.avg_difference
36:
WITH top_school AS (
    SELECT s."cds", s."sname", s."numge1500"
    FROM "satscores" s
    ORDER BY s."numge1500" DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    sch."admfname1" AS "first_name_1",
    sch."admlname1" AS "last_name_1",
    sch."admfname2" AS "first_name_2",
    sch."admlname2" AS "last_name_2",
    sch."admfname3" AS "first_name_3",
    sch."admlname3" AS "last_name_3"
FROM "schools" sch
JOIN top_school ts
  ON sch."cdscode" = ts."cds";

515:
SELECT
    c."originalreleasedate" AS release_date,
    l."format" AS play_format
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l
    ON l."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."rarity" = 'mythic'
  AND l."status" = 'Legal'
  AND c."originalreleasedate" = (
      SELECT MIN(c2."originalreleasedate")
      FROM "cards" c2
      WHERE c2."rarity" = 'mythic'
        AND c2."originalreleasedate" IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY l."format" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT
    c."id",
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c."isstoryspotlight" = '1' AND c."istextless" = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "percentage"

487:

    ROUND(
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN c."cardkingdomfoilid" IS NOT NULL
                 AND c."cardkingdomfoilid" <> ''
                 AND c."cardkingdomid" IS NOT NULL
                 AND c."cardkingdomid" <> ''
